The '''millitile''' was a long, serpentine creature from [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]] that migrated among [[gankto tree]]s. They climbed the tree's upper bare branches to eat [[symbiospore]] spores found there, then moved on.<ref name="guide">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref> 

It had a flat head, most of which was a large round mouth full of blunt teeth. Its body was carried by hundreds of tiny [[Limb/Legends|legs]], that offered its slithering motion. They could run, but only for short time.   While migrating between trees, they would fall prey to the [[myntor]]s and [[Hawk-bat/Legends|Hawk-bats]].<ref name="guide" />

The legs which were considered a delicacy by [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]], often served with tangy [[fruit/Legends|fuirt]] sauce, and reached high prices in food markets for [[hunting/Legends|hunters]]. When a millitile bit a larger creature, the spore residue in its mouth sometimes acted as a mild [[Poison/Legends|poison]] to the victim.<ref name="guide" />
